600	In English: And if He doesn't bring him back down in this lifetime, He'll bring him down in the next gilgul.	Em português: E se não o fizer descer de volta neste gilgul, fará descer no próximo gilgul.
601	Nothing is over, his term here hasn't ended.	Nada acabou, o mandato dele aqui não terminou.
602	Because this is what HaShem says: whoever is arrogant, even if he provides for...	Pois assim diz HaShem: todo aquele que se orgulha, mesmo que sustente...
603	the community. The Gemara says, Pesachim 66: if he is a sage, his wisdom leaves him; if a prophet,	a comunidade. A Guemará diz, Pesachim 66: se é sábio, sua sabedoria se afasta dele; se é profeta,	
604	his prophecy leaves him. Prophet, we learned from Devorah: "Awake, awake, Devorah, awake, awake, utter a song." And a sage,	sua profecia se afasta dele. Profeta, aprendemos de Devorah: "Desperta, desperta, Devorah, desperta, desperta, entoa um cântico." E sábio,	
605	we learned from Hillel the Babylonian, who was arrogant toward them. He said: who made me come up from Babylon? It was the laziness	aprendemos de Hilel, o Babilônio, que se orgulhou diante deles. Disse: quem me fez subir da Babilônia? Foi a preguiça	
606	in you, that you did not serve the great ones of the generation, Shemaya and Avtalyon. Immediately they asked him about a knife on Shabbat, on Pesach,	em vocês, que não serviram os grandes da geração, Shemaya e Avtalyon. Logo lhe perguntaram sobre uma faca no Shabat, em Pessach,	
607	and the halachah was hidden from him. Because he was arrogant toward them, the halachah was forgotten from him. And the same applies,	e a halachá lhe ficou oculta. Por ter se orgulhado diante deles, a halachá lhe foi esquecida. E o mesmo vale,	
608	the same applies if he is a prophet: Devorah grew arrogant, she said "until I arose, Devorah, until I arose, a mother in Israel,"	o mesmo vale se for profeta: Devorah se orgulhou, disse "até que eu me levantei, Devorah, até que me levantei, mãe em Israel,"	
609	and immediately "Awake, awake, Devorah" — the prophecy left her.	e logo "Desperta, desperta, Devorah" — a profecia se afastou dela.	
610	So when someone is arrogant, he forgets where he came from, forgets that he was a nobody,	Por isso, quando alguém se orgulha, esquece de onde veio, esquece que não era ninguém,	
611	some...	um...	
612	nothing. The Holy One, blessed be He, raised him up, to be a great rabbi, a great sage, to be very rich, to be	nada. O Santo, bendito seja, o elevou, para ser um grande rabino, um grande sábio, muito rico, para ser	
613	and he forgot Him, so the Holy One, blessed be He, brings him back down.	e ele se esqueceu Dele, então o Santo, bendito seja, o faz descer de volta.	
614	And that's what is written: "And Yosef was the ruler over the land." Even though he was a ruler over the land,	E é isso que está escrito: "E Yosef era o governante sobre a terra." Embora fosse governante sobre a terra,	
615	his feet were on the ground, he did not forget where he came from.	seus pés estavam no chão, ele não esqueceu de onde veio.	
616	And that's what they said to Avraham Avinu: "You are a prince of Elokim among us."	E é isso que disseram a Avraham Avinu: "És um príncipe de Elokim no meio de nós."	
617	Even though you are a prince of Elokim, you are great, yet you are among us, one of us, and you feel nothing special about yourself.	Embora sejas um príncipe de Elokim, és grande, mas estás entre nós, um de nós, e não sentes nada de especial em ti mesmo.	
618	How many times have I told about Rav Ben Zion Abba Shaul, who used to walk around these neighborhoods, he lived right here, he would	Quantas vezes contei sobre o Rav Ben Zion Abba Shaul, que andava por estes bairros, ele morava aqui mesmo,	
619	walk around here on Friday after Kiddush without a hat, without a jacket, only in his shirt, and the whole	andava por aqui na sexta-feira depois do Kidush sem chapéu, sem paletó, só de camisa, e todo o	
620	Shas he would review and recite by heart, and you would see him and not believe he was the gadol hador.	Shas ele repassava e recitava de cor, e você o via e não acreditava que era o gadol hador.	
621	You wouldn't believe he was one of the great ones of the generation.	Você não acreditaria que era um dos grandes da geração.	
622	Nothing.	Nada.	
623	He would walk along like that, delving into it, and you would see him here reviewing all of Shas, he made a round of all	Ele ia assim, aprofundando-se, e você o via aqui repassando todo o Shas, fazia uma volta por todos	
624	Geula, Beit Yisrael, the Bucharim, he made a round of everything, and finished the tractate they were learning.	Geula, Beit Yisrael, os Bucharim, fazia uma volta por tudo, e terminava o tratado que estudavam.	
625	What does he write in Zikaron LeTzion, in his book? That he and Chacham Ovadia were chavruta, and they would	O que ele escreve em Zikaron LeTzion, no seu livro? Que ele e o Chacham Ovadia eram chavruta, e	
626	walk from here, from these neighborhoods, all the way to Porat Yosef in the Old City, on foot.	iam daqui, destes bairros, até Porat Yosef na Cidade Velha, a pé.	
627	He says: Chacham Ovadia and I, the whole way, the sugya we had learned the day before in the Gemara, we would recite by heart.	Ele diz: eu e o Chacham Ovadia, todo o caminho, a sugyá que tínhamos estudado no dia anterior na Guemará, nós a recitávamos de cor.	
628	He says: what was the difference between him and me?	Ele diz: qual era a diferença entre ele e eu?	
629	That he also remembered the names of the sages, and I didn't, I didn't remember the names of the sages.	Que ele lembrava também os nomes dos sábios, e eu não, eu não lembrava os nomes dos sábios.	
630	He would say, Rav Kahana says, Rabbi Akiva says, Rabbi says.	Ele dizia: Rav Kahana diz, Rabi Akiva diz, Rabi diz.	
631	And I would say, there is one who says this, there is one who says that.	E eu dizia: há quem diga isto, há quem diga aquilo.	
632	And that was the difference between us.	E essa era a diferença entre nós.	
633	And how many tried to scheme against both of them, and the two of them were gedolei hador, Yissachar and Zevulun.	E quantos tentaram conspirar contra os dois, e os dois eram gedolei hador, Yissachar e Zevulun.	
634	They were like Yissachar and Zevulun.	Eram como Yissachar e Zevulun.	
635	Great ones of Israel, both of them Yissachars, both great ones of Israel.	Grandes de Israel, ambos Yissachars, ambos grandes de Israel.	
636	And they merited a crown and greatness in one place.	E mereceram coroa e grandeza num mesmo lugar.	
637	What do you say, Shammai?	O que você diz, Shamai?	
638	Wait, what, are you saying that Yosef would have punched Potifar's	Espera, como assim, você está dizendo que Yosef daria um soco na	
639	wife?	mulher de Potifar?
